prompt.en: In what year were most Canadian women aged 21 and over granted the right to vote in federal elections?
prompt.fr: En quelle année la plupart des Canadiennes de 21 ans et plus ont-elles obtenu le droit de voter aux élections fédérales?

explanation.en: Ottawa moved in two steps. In 1917 it enfranchised nurses serving at the battle front, then wives, mothers and sisters of serving men. A year later the vote in federal elections went to almost every woman citizen of 21 or over.
explanation.fr: Ottawa a agi en deux temps. En 1917, il a donné le droit de vote aux infirmières servant au front, puis aux épouses, mères et sœurs des militaires. Un an plus tard, le vote aux élections fédérales revenait à presque toutes les citoyennes de 21 ans et plus.

source.quote: In 1918, most Canadian female citizens aged 21 and over were granted the right to vote in federal elections.

verification.evidence: In 1917, thanks to the leadership of women such as Dr. Stowe and other suffragettes, the federal government of Sir Robert Borden gave women the right to vote in federal elections—first to nurses at the battle front, then to women who were related to men in active wartime service. In 1918, most Canadian female citizens aged 21 and over were granted the right to vote in federal elections.
